caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned teapot, rendered in shades of gray using stippling and shading techniques to create depth and texture. The teapot features a domed lid with a finial, a wide curved handle on the left, and a long, elegantly curved spout on the right. The body of the teapot is composed of a broad, rounded lower section, a narrower midsection, and a wide, slightly flared base that rests flat on the surface. The background is an off-white or cream-colored paper, bordered by a faint rectangular outline. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing only black and gray tones, and is signed "KARL JOUBERT" in the lower right corner. There is a slightly discolored or stained area along the right edge of the paper.
title: Pewter Teapot
